title: dryopteris basilaris
intro: Dryopteris basilaris, commonly known as Spiny Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Spiny Wood Fern are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties, achieved through its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents in Spiny Wood Fern contribute to its potential in treating infections, wounds, and other diseases, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities.
